categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: (1) superstructure building and RMAA (repair, maintenance, alteration and addition) works service as a main contractor in Hong Kong, focusing on residential and commercial building projects; and (2) reverse supply chain management and environmental-related services, including trading of industrial materials and recycling of retired EV batteries, with a focus on battery re-engineering and energy storage solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes self-developed technologies for re-engineering retired lithium-ion batteries into battery energy storage systems. It employs advanced equipment and technology in its EV battery processing plant, and integrates green infrastructure initiatives such as battery energy storage systems and EV charging facilities. The company also emphasizes sustainable construction practices and environmental protection measures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include construction project developers for residential and commercial buildings in Hong Kong, as well as industrial clients requiring reverse supply chain and environmental services. The company serves global markets with a focus on mature electrification regions such as Europe, the Americas, and Asia, providing green energy management solutions and battery recycling services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is rooted in Hong Kong with significant operations there, including its main contractor services and the EV battery processing plant. It also operates across the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and has established over 70 service locations globally in Europe, the Americas, and Asia to support its recycling network and green energy solutions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It acts as a main contractor in construction (downstream) and manages reverse supply chain activities including battery recycling and trading of industrial materials (midstream), facilitating closed-loop battery lifecycle management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding the green business, particularly in power battery recycling and energy storage systems, supporting low-carbon transformation and circular economy development. The company focuses on innovation in battery re-engineering, green infrastructure, and compliance with global regulations. It also invests in technology adoption, strategic partnerships, and expanding its global footprint.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through contract-based service fees from superstructure building and RMAA works, and sales/trading in reverse supply chain management and environmental-related services. The latter includes revenue from battery recycling, industrial material trading, and provision of green energy solutions such as battery energy storage and EV charging infrastructure.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a leading player in Hong Kong’s construction and green energy sectors, with a differentiated competitive advantage in global power battery recycling due to comprehensive licensing and local operational teams. It leverages strategic partnerships with automakers and battery suppliers to strengthen its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenue of HK$869.7 million for the year ended March 2025, a 92.3% increase from the previous year, driven mainly by growth in reverse supply chain and environmental services. It achieved a turnaround from loss to adjusted EBITDA profit of HK$44.8 million. The company has a moderate scale with 54 employees and is investing significantly in capital expenditures and expansion projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes sustainable development and green innovation, offering integrated green energy management solutions and a global recycling network. Its unique value lies in advanced battery recycling technology, comprehensive licensing across key markets, and the ability to provide closed-loop battery lifecycle management. It also differentiates through its commitment to environmental compliance, strategic partnerships, and localized service responsiveness.
